speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Over the Bridge for the first time since May, slowly, and home by the Bridge again to save the penny.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: This king never doubts. He stands under the June gilt throne in his gilded mail and fills the house like water in a jug, and the yard loves it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Their king is all is. Mine is all seems. Five weeks.
